message.content: The pain started about two days ago in the middle of my back between the shoulder blades and it hasn’t spread anywhere. I’m not really sure how to describe the feeling – it’s just there. Nothing seems to set it off or make it worse; I haven’t noticed it getting worse with moving, coughing, bending or anything else.
